colophon: Every question was checked against current guidance; {corrected} questions were corrected and all explanations shortened. Each change is logged in the accompanying corrections file.
This book is a revision aid. Guidelines change: always check current local and national guidance.

chapters.title: Coronary & Vascular Disease
chapters.intro: Stable and unstable coronary disease, myocardial infarction and its complications, peripheral arterial and venous disease, and diseases of the aorta.

chapters.title: Heart Failure & Cardiomyopathy
chapters.intro: Acute and chronic heart failure across the ejection-fraction spectrum, the drugs that change prognosis, and the cardiomyopathies.

chapters.title: Congenital Heart Disease
chapters.intro: Shunts, obstructive lesions and cyanotic disease in children and adults: murmurs, ECG and X-ray clues, and when to intervene.

chapters.title: Arrhythmias & Conduction Disease
chapters.intro: Atrial fibrillation, supraventricular and ventricular tachycardias, heart block and cardiac arrest: ECG recognition, rate and rhythm control, and anticoagulation.

chapters.title: Valvular Heart Disease
chapters.intro: Aortic and mitral stenosis and regurgitation, right-sided valve disease and prosthetic valves: bedside signs, echo criteria and timing of intervention.

chapters.title: Pericardial & Inflammatory Heart Disease
chapters.intro: Pericarditis, tamponade and constriction; infective endocarditis; myocarditis; and rheumatic fever — the inflammatory diseases of the heart and their look-alikes.

chapters.title: Hypertension
chapters.intro: Diagnosis and grading, investigation for target-organ damage and secondary causes, drug choice, and hypertensive emergencies.

chapters.title: Cardiovascular Pharmacology
chapters.intro: Mechanisms, indications, interactions and adverse effects of antiplatelets, anticoagulants, antianginals, antiarrhythmics and lipid-lowering drugs.

chapters.title: Mixed Cardiology
chapters.intro: Integrated cardiology questions across the whole system — examination, investigation and management — for final revision.

chapters.title: Cardiology EMQs
chapters.intro: Extended matching questions on the cardiovascular system: chest pain, murmurs, pulses, ECGs, arrhythmias and cardiovascular drugs.

chapters.title: Obstructive Airway Disease
chapters.intro: Asthma and COPD side by side: diagnosis and spirometry, acute severe attacks and exacerbations, oxygen, ventilation and long-term management.

chapters.title: Respiratory Infection & Inflammation
chapters.intro: Pneumonia, tuberculosis, bronchiectasis, lung abscess and granulomatous disease: organisms, severity assessment and treatment.

chapters.title: Respiratory Failure & ARDS
chapters.intro: Type 1 and type 2 respiratory failure, blood gases, oxygen and non-invasive ventilation, and the acute respiratory distress syndrome.

chapters.title: Pleural Disease
chapters.intro: Pleural effusion, empyema, pneumothorax and haemothorax: Light criteria, aspiration and drainage, and mesothelioma.

chapters.title: Interstitial Lung Disease
chapters.intro: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, sarcoidosis, hypersensitivity pneumonitis, occupational and drug-induced lung disease.

chapters.title: Pulmonary Vascular Disease
chapters.intro: Pulmonary embolism — probability, imaging and treatment — and pulmonary hypertension.

chapters.title: Lung Cancer
chapters.intro: Presentation, paraneoplastic syndromes, diagnosis, staging and treatment of lung cancer and other thoracic tumours.

chapters.title: Mixed Respiratory Medicine
chapters.intro: Integrated respiratory questions across the whole system for final revision.

chapters.title: Respiratory EMQs
chapters.intro: Extended matching questions on the respiratory system: breathlessness, haemoptysis, clubbing, chest X-rays, blood gases and pleural fluid.
